title: Voice logging is merged; it goes live at your next Servex restart

owner_note.text: Note: the Claude-app voice agent now files your exact words ("owner_words" on every tool) in a voice session folder, logs every tool call so a missing one shows as a gap, and can call register_session with no arguments to get a session for session_summary. Pick the time to run node Servex/sustain.mjs --restart (never mid-call). The merge smoke test fails on /framework/ai/ for a console-noise budget unrelated to this change (Doc "has no member" messages, expired allow-list entries), so it was merged with --skip-smoke; it touched only Servex/ext/remote.
